entries.20d6835a2e484c98: Renewable Energy Power Generation and Related Business
entries.239afd60713ea77f: A business that owns and operates renewable energy power plants (solar, biomass, onshore wind and geothermal) and grid-connected storage facilities over the long term, selling the electricity generated and its environmental value to offtakers through FIT and FIP schemes, power sales contracts and other arrangements, and also selling the balancing capacity and capacity-securing value of storage facilities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥86,429 million.
